appDescription: A coastal-leaning stage from Stjärneberg to Lilla Laxemar. The route leaves the Stjärneberg cabin area, passes Tjustgölen, Djurvadsnäs, Kråkemåla and Bussviken, then continues by Granholmsfjärden, Kärrsvik, coastal slabs with natural swimming opportunities, Ekerum and finally Lilla Laxemar. The official GPX is continuous but stored in reverse, so normalization must reverse it. Water and access need care: Stjärneberg has unresolved historical/currentness caveats, Lilla Laxemar water is seasonal, and many intermediate swim/POI coordinates are approximate.

hunting.summary: Latest official Kalmar moose-hunt decision found for 2025/2026 ended before 2026-04-29; no 2026/2027 decision found by access date. Naturkartan route API contains an English-only hunting notice for October 8-January 31, which was outside the access date.

fire.summary: Oskarshamn page said no fire ban at access, but forest-fire-risk warning was visible through Länsstyrelsen/SMHI context. Same-day recheck needed. Cabin-specific no-outdoor-fire rules apply at both endpoints.

forestry.summary: Skogsstyrelsen public felling layer shows one notice intersecting GPX, A 54522-2023 received 2023-11-03, 1.5 ha registered and 0.55 ha shown as carried out in season 2024/2025. Two fresh nearby notices from 2026-04-14 are within about 120 m and 370 m of the route: A 18318-2026 3.0 ha and A 18330-2026 3.1 ha. These are not trail closures but are current disturbance/passability risks.

waterProtection.summary: Oskarshamn lists Bockara, Kristdala, Fårbo, Hummeln, Djupeträsk, Eckern and Älvehult as municipal water-protection areas; none appear to intersect Etapp 6 in the rules lane pass.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Six lanes produced sufficient evidence for a research-ready file. Follow-up caveat-resolution check on 2026-04-29 resolved the Stjärneberg closure/arsenic contradiction as not source-reproducible; remaining issues are explicit currentness/import caveats around publication-time cabin/well checks, approximate coastal POIs, and forestry notice verification.

openQuestions: Verify Stjärneberg cabin availability and well quality wording at publication time before user-facing accommodation/water claims.
Reverse official Etapp 6 GPX during normalization and visually verify against the PDF/map viewer.

Verify exact coordinates for Tjustgölen bathing access, Bussvik/Bussviken swim and stone-shipping remains, Kärrsvik swim/loading-quay context, Ekerum swimming, coastal slabs after Kärrsvik, and Djurvadsnäs cairns before importing as point POIs.
Verify Stjärneberg well coordinate and current water quality wording before importing any water point.
Verify Lilla Laxemar water line/winter-water access and exact dry toilet coordinate before user-facing water/toilet details.
Check Skogsstyrelsen felling notices A 54522-2023, A 18318-2026 and A 18330-2026 plus on-site signage/current maintainer notes before assuming unobstructed passage.
Verify KLT 44/45 and Närtrafik service in current planner before publication, especially weekend/Sunday availability.
Do not model Lilla Laxemar as guaranteed parking unless an official parking source is found.
